visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a night view of a sleek, modern multi-story glass building featuring white architectural curves. Bold white text overlays the center. The setting is an urban street at night with bright artificial lights illuminating the structure. (2) The camera transitions inside to a luxury display labeled 'Perfume Library'. A long, irregular silver table holds various glass perfume bottles and shopping bags from the brand 'Rbow'. The lighting is bright and studio-like, focusing on the product textures. (3) Outside the main entrance, a female character with short dark hair, wearing a blue scarf and dark coat, waves enthusiastically at the camera. Above her, a large glowing 'OLIVE YOUNG SEONGSU' sign is visible. (4) The character pushes through large glass double doors to enter the store. The background reveals a clean, spacious retail environment with white ceilings and green accents. (5) On the first floor, a cafe area and a 'Derma Village' exhibition are shown, featuring a whimsical white slide and snow-like decorations. Customers are seen sitting on circular wooden benches in a well-lit atrium. (6) The character travels up a glass-sided escalator to the second floor, looking around with a surprised expression. The floor is packed with shoppers browsing 'Luxe Edit' and 'Men's Edit' sections under bright, grid-patterned ceiling lights. (7) Close-ups of specific beauty products follow, including Rbow perfumes and displays for brands like HERA and Urban Decay on sleek black and white shelves. The character is shown smelling a perfume sample. (8) The tour continues through 'Color Makeup' zones featuring brands like Amuse and 3CE. Multiple shoppers are seen testing lipsticks and foundations. (9) On the third floor, titled 'Skin & Wellness', a floor guide is mounted on a wall. Aisles are filled with K-beauty skincare products, including a wall of Abib sheet masks. (10) The final shopping scenes show a 'Food Market' section with snacks and drinks, followed by the character at a green-branded checkout counter receiving a paper bag. (11) The video ends with a mirror selfie of the character in her blue scarf, followed by a close-up of her hand covered in various shades of red and pink lipstick swatches.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, approximately 20-25 other customers and staff visible in background throughout the store floors.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with short, dark, straight hair. She is wearing a prominent cobalt blue knit scarf, a dark grey or black oversized blazer coat, and a white top underneath.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior of a massive, multi-story Olive Young flagship store in Seongsu. It features high ceilings, modern industrial-chic aesthetic with exposed pipes, white and pink color schemes in makeup sections, wooden shelving in skincare zones, and bright, uniform LED lighting. Glass escalators connect floors. There is a cafe area with wooden benches and a whimsical exhibition space with white mounds and a slide.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy female voice opens with a bright, professional greeting over an upbeat pop BGM track featuring a steady electronic drum beat. The vocal pitch is high, and the articulation is very clear. (2) As the tour begins, the voice describes the 'Beauty Paradise'. The BGM remains consistent in the background at a moderate volume. Slight indoor room tone and faint distant chatter can be heard. (3) Upon entering the store, a subtle transition sound effect is audible. The speaker's arousal increases while mentioning the five floors of the flagship store. (4) Detailed narration follows for each floor. The music maintains a constant 124 BPM tempo. Faint rustling of clothing and footwear on hard floors is occasionally perceptible behind the voice. (5) When smelling perfume, the speaker lets out a short, soft vocalization of approval. The BGM swells slightly during transitions between product close-ups. (6) In the crowded makeup sections, the background crowd murmur intensity rises slightly but remains well below the main vocal signal. (7) During the checkout phase, the faint sound of a plastic shopping bag being handled is heard. (8) The video concludes with the main speaker asking a closing question with a rising intonation. A final male voice is heard briefly in the background at the very end, asking a question about swatches.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Floor 1 Tour -> Floor 2 Tour -> Floor 3 Tour -> Food/Checkout -> Outro with CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a comprehensive virtual tour and recommendation for the new Olive Young Seongsu flagship store, highlighting its scale, variety of K-beauty brands, and unique features like the cafe and testing zones.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct naming of the store (Olive Young Seongsu), showcasing brand logos, and encouraging viewers to visit and comment on their favorite products.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a very fast-paced montage style typical of short-form social media travel/shopping vlogs. The high-energy narration and bright color grade enhance the appeal of the retail destination.
